#### 1. tropical pancreatitis  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.500)

**Proposed mechanism:** SPINK1 (HGNC:11244) —DISRUPTS→ trypsin activity regulation (REACT:R-HSA-6799026); PRSS1 (HGNC:9824) —DISRUPTS→ trypsin activity regulation (REACT:R-HSA-6799026); trypsin activity regulation (REACT:R-HSA-6799026) —LEADS_TO→ pancreatic acinar cell function (REACT:R-HSA-195712); pancreatic acinar cell function (REACT:R-HSA-195712) —LEADS_TO→ chronic pancreatitis (HP:0005207); pancreatic acinar cell function (REACT:R-HSA-195712) —LEADS_TO→ tropical pancreatitis (MONDO:0011986). Mutations in SPINK1 and PRSS1 disrupt the normal regulation of trypsin activity, leading to impaired pancreatic acinar cell function, which manifests as chronic pancreatitis in hereditary forms and tropical pancreatitis.

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared mechanistic link could enable the development of targeted therapies for both hereditary and tropical pancreatitis, potentially by modulating trypsin activity or protecting pancreatic acinar cells.
